faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Here are the most common questions from our customers to help you find what you need.
faq.no_answer: Can't find what you're looking for?
faq.contact_team: Please feel free to contact our customer service team. We're here to help.
faq.q1: How is the shipping cost calculated?
faq.a1: Free shipping for orders over NT$1,000. For orders under NT$1,000, home delivery is NT$100 and convenience store pickup is NT$60.
faq.a2: In-stock items ship within 1-2 business days. Pre-order items take 7-14 business days. Delivery takes 1-2 days for home delivery and 2-3 days for store pickup.
faq.q3: Can I modify or cancel my order?
faq.a3: If the order is 'Processing', contact support for help. Once 'Shipped', it cannot be changed. You may process a return after receiving the items.
faq.q4: What if I receive a defective item?
faq.a4: We are sorry! If you receive a defective or incorrect item, contact us within 7 days with photos or videos. we will arrange a free replacement.
faq.q5: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a5: We accept Credit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, JCB), LINE Pay, JKO Pay, and ATM transfer. All transactions are encrypted and secure.
faq.a6: Currently we focus on online sales to provide the best prices. Any future store openings will be announced on our website and social media.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.subtitle: Learn about our delivery methods, shipping costs, and estimated delivery times.
shipping.home_delivery_desc: Delivered by professional logistics companies, fast and safe.
shipping.free_shipping_desc: Free shipping on orders over NT$ 1,000 (includes Home Delivery and Store Pickup).
shipping.stock_item_desc: Ships within 1-2 business days after payment (excluding weekends and holidays).
shipping.preorder_item_desc: Requires 7-14 business days. We will notify you if there's a manufacturer shortage.
shipping.timeline_desc: Home delivery takes 1-2 days; Store pickup takes 2-3 days to reach the store.
shipping.international_desc1: We provide international shipping to select Asian regions (Hong Kong, Macau, Singapore, Malaysia).
shipping.international_desc2: Costs are calculated based on weight and destination at checkout. Note that international packages may incur customs duties at the buyer's expense.
shipping.disclaimer: * Gravito Shop reserves the right to modify shipping policies. Changes will be posted on the website without notice.

returns.title: Returns & Refunds Policy
returns.subtitle: Shop with confidence. We offer comprehensive after-sales protection.
returns.guarantee_desc: Gravito Shop offers a 7-day inspection period. If you are not satisfied, you can apply for a return within 7 days of receipt with no extra cost.
returns.guarantee_note: (*Inspection period is not a trial period. Returned items must be brand new and in original packaging.)
returns.step1_desc: Contact us within 7 days of receipt via email or form. Please include order number and reason.
returns.step2_desc: After approval, we will provide a return code or arrange logistics pickup.
returns.step3_desc: Keep items brand new and unopened. Include invoice and any gifts in the package.
returns.step4_desc: After inspecting the returned items, we will complete the refund within 7-10 business days.
returns.invalid_item2: Items opened or used (except for defects).
returns.invalid_item3: Stains or damage caused by user.
returns.invalid_item5: Personal items (underwear, socks) for hygiene reasons.
returns.credit_card_desc: Refunded to original card. Posting time depends on your bank.
returns.atm_desc: Provide bank info. Refund will be wired within 7-10 business days.
